validationRules.description: Event is produced only after the authoritative domain transition is accepted; atomic outbox/equivalent durability is required for transactional mutations.
Every semantic occurrence has one globally unique eventId.
Retrying the same idempotent command must return/reuse the original outcome and must not emit a second semantic fact event.
Payload contains only data required by declared consumers; consumers fetch additional authorized data separately when needed.
Payload must never contain API secrets, auth tokens, signing secrets, raw payment-card data or other credentials.
Organization/Site scope must match the authoritative subject and producing operation.
Event semantics do not depend on webhook, queue, HTTP, database or provider transport implementation.
Personal data is minimized and may require redaction in logs, diagnostics and external delivery.
